### Structural gaps

These do not block an A grade — no implementation could produce real data here because the underlying data source cannot exist in an emulator.

- Terraform, EXTERNAL and CodeStar-sourced products have no engine inside the emulator: an engine would have to call Notify*EngineWorkflowResult itself.
